answer_text:
Several affordable CRMs now include email sequences without a separate sales-engagement tool. Good choices:

1. Pipewell - easy to adopt, but email features cost extra.
2. Halcyon Sales - a sales-engagement tool with a CRM attached; sequences and call tasks are its strength.
3. Northwind CRM Essentials - powerful and well supported, though per-seat costs climb quickly past the starter tier.
4. Tallyfox - simple pipelines, a mobile app people actually use and pricing from $12 per user; reporting is lighter than the big suites.
5. Brightdesk - a help desk with light CRM features — fine if support is your main workflow.
6. Kestrel CRM - promising and free to start, though the integration list is still short.

Start with Pipewell if you want the quickest setup; shortlist Halcyon Sales if you expect to need deeper reporting.
